name: SAVA 萨瓦 A7L Pro 2026
why_interesting: A current exact 2026 R08/R7120 complete bike with a dated mainland price, 105 2×12 hydraulic build, carbon wheels and official geometry.
missing: Current domestic warranty and support route
Final mainland checkout conditions, stock, size and component-substitution confirmation
source_note: Current exact manufacturer evidence lists the 2026 A7L PRO R08-R7120-24S at approximately 8.8 kg varying by size. The current manufacturer compatibility guide maps the exact R08 frame, including A7L PRO, to a nominal 25C maximum. September22 follow-up adds attributed qualitative ride evidence with its build and source caveats; no exact-model numeric stiffness result was found after 50 areas.

facts.frame: R08 T800 carbon frame and fork
facts.wheels: 50 mm carbon, 21 mm internal / 28 mm external
facts.complete_weight_basis: Current exact manufacturer approximate claim; weight varies by size, while pedals, accessories and weighing protocol are unpublished
facts.tire_clearance_status: Manufacturer R08 maximum 25C recorded; fitted 25C tire is not treated as clearance
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Current SAVA manufacturer compatibility guide maps the R08 frame, including A7L PRO, to up to 25C; nominal tire designation with no rim-width or measured-clearance protocol
facts.frame_stiffness_status: Qualitative ride evidence is available; no numeric frame-only measurement is recorded.
facts.stiffness_evidence: An exact A7L Pro review reports responsive behavior under power and a firmer ride than a Trek Domane with IsoSpeed after a reported500km. These are subjective whole-bike impressions from an affiliate-supported review, not an isolated-frame measurement or stiffness ranking.
